engines.quant: ternary weights (-1, 0, +1) with group-wise scales; 0.95GB footprint; 32 concurrent streams processing 250 emails into JSON with summaries, action items, calendar events and priority scoring; peak memory under 4GB; over 700 tokens per second in total across all 32 streams; up to 5x throughput and 3x energy efficiency vs full-precision on RTX 4090 and M5 Pro

engines.hardware: Apple M5 Max Pro; iPhone 18 Pro Max
